requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Together, the layout and views support an approximately 12-minute adult visit incorporating a character encounter, contribution activity, photograph opportunity and browsing of all three merchandise lines. A photo opportunity may be integrated into an exhibit rather than occupy a separate booth. Missing experiences or a route that makes the intended visit implausible fail.

The proposal uses three tangible exhibits, a mechanical token interaction and readable printed interpretation. MH-01 is the existing vinyl figure, MH-02 is a brass bell with a stationary clapper, and MH-03 is a birch tray with reusable wooden tokens. A screen-only substitute for an exhibit, interpretation or the mechanical activity fails.

The installation's scale and placement are compatible with the 40 × 32 m atrium and allocated area in plan-with-cameras.png. C1 and C2 use their respective camera positions and preserve the surrounding occupied-mall context of view-c1.png and view-c2.png. Cropped drawings are acceptable; a rescaled site, relocated allocation or unrelated viewpoint fails.

Each board must explain a spatial proposal through story order, physical participation, retail relationship and fixture placement. Across the three boards, these spatial decisions must offer meaningfully different alternatives. Cosmetic changes to an otherwise identical scheme do not count as distinct directions.

The register explicitly selects one identifiable board direction. The presentation establishes the three alternatives before the selection decision and repeats the selected direction's name on page one. Ambiguous, multiple or inconsistent selections fail; no additional proof of export timestamps is required.

Use the register to identify the chosen board, then compare the final images with its story sequence, activity concept, retail relationship and fixture arrangement. Development and detailing are allowed; replacing the selected spatial concept or combining incompatible alternatives without following the recorded selection fails.

The one-page register must record the selected direction, visit order and complete exhibit records: MH-01 The Collector, 2026, The Collection, 110 × 90 × 180 mm; MH-02 The Quiet Bell, 2026, The Collection, 90 × 90 × 140 mm; MH-03 A Place for Your Find, 2026, Your Find, a 300 × 200 × 30 mm tray with 12 tokens of 40 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness. The copy sheet must record the 30-word body limit, 900 mm plinth tops, 1400 mm label centres and these exact English bodies: 'Morrow collects overlooked things and gives each one a place to belong.'; 'This bell has lost its sound. Morrow keeps it for the shape of its silence.'; 'Choose a token and turn the wheel. Your small discovery becomes part of Morrow's collection.' Record the ordered steps 'Pick a token', 'Turn the wheel', 'Leave your find'. The presentation must repeat all exhibit IDs, names, years and zones, all three bodies and steps, and both mounting heights. Omitted fields, changed copy or mismatched assignments fail.

Both drawings must carry all three exhibit IDs paired with their correct names, 2026 years and zones. The section sheet additionally reproduces the three approved label bodies and ordered activity steps without wording changes and dimensions 900 mm plinth tops and 1400 mm label centres. A schedule or callout is acceptable if its connection to the correct exhibit is unambiguous. Missing records or text assigned to the wrong exhibit fail.

Preserve the 6000 mm east–west by 8000 mm north–south boundary, 1500 mm external strip, entrance at x 0–1500/y 0 and exit at x 4500–6000/y 0. Dimension 1500 mm clear openings and main routes. Reserve the stockroom at x 0–6000/y 6500–8000, service at x 4500–6000/y 4500–6500 and queue at x 3000–6000/y 1500–4500, with respective sizes 6000 × 1500, 1500 × 2000 and 3000 × 3000 mm. Provide six queue positions in two returning lanes and a free participation route directly to the exit with optional shopping. Open operation shows 12 indoor visitors, six additional queuers, host, attendant and cashier, exposed exhibits, displayed SKUs and the token reset arrangement. Closed operation retains fixture positions, covers exhibits, locks merchandise and tokens in the north stockroom, closes checkout and puts both closure barriers inside the footprint. Any count, reservation, clearance, route or state contradiction fails.

Dimension the 3200 mm maximum height, 600 mm frontage for each named retail SKU and 1500 mm checkout length. Account for 12 aluminium frames and eight 18 mm birch plywood plinths through 24 uprights, 24 rails, 48 hand-knob corner blocks, 12 fabric skins, 48 plywood panels and 96 quarter-turn cams. Identify tool-free frame hand knobs and plinth cams operated with a flat-head screwdriver. State a 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm largest dismantled part and four cases. Assembly and packing details must agree with 1000 × 2000 mm frames, 2000 mm uprights, 1000 mm rails, 1000 × 2000 mm skins, 500 × 500 × 900 mm plinths, 32 side panels/eight tops/eight bases, and 2100 × 1100 × 650 mm cases. Missing counts, contradictory materials or dimensions, or unsupported packing fail.

The presentation must include a readable kit schedule agreeing with the section: 12 frames, eight plinths, component counts 24/24/48/12/48/96 assigned to uprights/rails/corner blocks/skins/panels/cams, both specified connection methods, the 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm largest dismantled part and four cases. Readable reuse of the original schedule is acceptable. A generic kit description or omitted schedule entries fails.

The two views must realize the planned exhibit, activity and retail positions and show the exact required entrance title and phrase. Preserve the reference figure's bean-shaped warm-ivory body, flat base, two short ears with its own left ear notched, two black oval eyes, smooth lower face, square rust-orange satchel on the right hip and deep-teal diagonal strap. MR-01 matches MH-01 and the reference figure, MR-02 retains the orange square satchel motif, and MR-03 uses Morrow's established identity. Perspective and lighting variation are allowed; changed anatomy, product identity or spatial placement fails.

Provide entrance artwork carrying 'MORROW HOUSE' and 'Leave a little wonder', three destination signs reading 'The Collection', 'Your Find' and 'Shop', an 'Exit' sign and a 'Queue here' sign. Zone wording must agree with the register, and any directional arrows must agree with the plan. Artwork arrangement may vary; missing signs, renamed destinations or misleading directions fail.

Review the whole video and its duration: it must run for 12 seconds, develop the selected scheme and traverse entrance, story, activity and exit while showing the optional shop branch. Show an actual token lifted from the starting tray, placed in a wheel pocket and rotated into the visible channel, then released into the return tray. Spatial positions and Morrow's reference features must stay consistent with the drawings and supplied character references. Cuts are allowed; missing token motion, an omitted route stage, a changed layout or incorrect duration fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation must visibly reuse every listed source in readable form and communicate the comparison and selection. Cropping and page composition may vary if the reused work remains identifiable and useful. Merely naming a source or replacing it with unrelated new artwork fails.

Require at least eight pages and a fact-location table that identifies an actual deliverable plus page or named view for every fixed site, object, character, operating and fixture fact in the supplied facts and object records. Include project context such as Alder Court Mall, 6–22 November 2026 and daily 10:00–21:00, alongside geometry, exhibit and merchandise records, character details, capacities, free admission/activity and kit data. Grouped rows are acceptable only when every fact and its location remain unambiguous. Generic category references, missing facts or locations that do not contain the claimed evidence fail.

Exhibit associations, zone names and interpretation agree with the written schedules wherever their respective content is required. Printed directions lead to the corresponding story, activity, shop, queue and exit locations.
